description: Deletes ONE campaign for good: its people, every message sent and the replies go with it; it cannot be undone. The first call (confirmed false or absent) changes nothing and returns what would be deleted (people, messages sent, replies) and the signals that feed it (each is paused unless another campaign reads it); the call with confirmed true deletes. Archiving a campaign instead keeps its history. Free. Only a workspace owner or admin can delete, never with an API key.

confirmed.description: true deletes; false or absent returns what would be deleted and changes nothing.
